# Mortal Shell II Guide

> Fan-made community guide hub for Mortal Shell II (mortalshell2.online), an English-language souls-like game guide site. Game facts are checked against the official Steam page and mortalshell.com; launch-specific data (shell stats, weapon costs, boss names) is marked as pending and will be verified against the release build.

## Pages

- [Mortal Shell 2 Beginner Guide](https://mortalshell2.online/beginner-guide/): no-stamina combat and the resolve economy, Standard vs Devout Edition early-access timing, and what gets confirmed at launch
- [Mortal Shell 2 Best Build](https://mortalshell2.online/best-build/): the eight shells as build classes, resolve and sidearm synergy, and the attributed early community consensus on burst DPS
- [Mortal Shell 2 Walkthrough](https://mortalshell2.online/walkthrough/): world structure — an interconnected open world with 60+ dungeons — and what exploration off the golden path rewards
- [Mortal Shell 2 Shells](https://mortalshell2.online/shells/): all eight lost warrior shells, possession, innate abilities, and the memories that unlock each shell's story
- [Mortal Shell 2 Weapons](https://mortalshell2.online/weapons/): melee blades and ranged sidearms, strategic upgrade tracks, and the posture-break system that enables critical execution strikes
- [Mortal Shell 2 Tips](https://mortalshell2.online/tips/): resolve generation through aggression and non-linear dungeon exploration

## Key facts (verified 2026-08-17 against official sources)

- Release date: August 20, 2026 (out now), worldwide, on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S
- Developer: Cold Symmetry. Publisher: Playstack
- Combat has no stamina gauge: landing aggressive melee hits generates resolve, which funds defensive skills and weapon arts
- Eight possessable lost-warrior shells, each with a unique ability tree and personal lore unlocked through memories
- The world is a compact, interconnected open world containing more than 60 dungeons
- Consecutive melee strikes build posture damage; a full posture break staggers enemies for critical execution strikes
- The Devout Edition grants up to 72 hours of advance access before the worldwide release

- Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2584270/Mortal_Shell_II/
